name: Corn & Soybean Backwardation/Contango Regime Analysis
description: Analyzes backwardation vs contango regimes in ZC (corn) and ZS (soybeans) using futures continuation carry (M1/M2 - 1) as the curve slope signal. Shows: (1) time series of front-to-second month spread with regime coloring (blue=backwardation, red=contango) for both markets, (2) summary table with % days in backwardation/contango per market, average carry in each regime, and hit rate of backwardation predicting positive next-quarter (63-day) carry. Uses NoAdjustment for both contracts to preserve true price levels. ZS loaded via reference_futures + futures_continuation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN & SOYBEAN BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO REGIME ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
#
# Signal: cont.carry = M1/M2 - 1
#   Positive = backwardation (front > deferred) → roll yield positive
#   Negative = contango (front < deferred)      → roll yield negative
#
# Regime coloring: split carry into two series
#   Backwardation (carry > 0) → Blue
#   Contango      (carry < 0) → Red
#
# Predictive test: does backwardation today predict positive carry 63 days ahead?
#   Hit rate = % of backwardation days where forward_carry_63d > 0
#
# NoAdjustment for both ZC and ZS — preserves true price levels for carry signals.
# ZS loaded via reference_futures → futures_continuation (proper front-month).
# =============================================================================

# --- ZC (Corn): Primary asset ---
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_carry = zc_cont.carry

# --- ZS (Soybeans): Reference asset via continuation ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- Regime flags ---
# ZC
zc_in_backwardation = is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry > 0
zc_in_contango      = is_valid(zc_carry) and zc_carry < 0

# ZS
zs_in_backwardation = is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry > 0
zs_in_contango      = is_valid(zs_carry) and zs_carry < 0

# --- Regime-colored carry series (NaN when not in that regime) ---
# ZC
zc_carry_back = where(zc_in_backwardation, zc_carry)   # Blue: positive carry
zc_carry_cont = where(zc_in_contango, zc_carry)         # Red: negative carry

# ZS
zs_carry_back = where(zs_in_backwardation, zs_carry)
zs_carry_cont = where(zs_in_contango, zs_carry)

# --- Forward carry: 63-day ahead carry value (next quarter) ---
# Does today's regime predict positive carry 63 days from now?
zc_fwd_carry_63 = forward_returns(period=63)(zc_carry)
zs_fwd_carry_63 = forward_returns(period=63)(zs_carry)

# --- Regime-conditional forward carry ---
# ZC: forward carry when currently in backwardation vs contango
zc_fwd_back = where(zc_in_backwardation, zc_fwd_carry_63)
zc_fwd_cont = where(zc_in_contango, zc_fwd_carry_63)

# ZS: forward carry when currently in backwardation vs contango
zs_fwd_back = where(zs_in_backwardation, zs_fwd_carry_63)
zs_fwd_cont = where(zs_in_contango, zs_fwd_carry_63)

# --- Hit rate: backwardation predicting positive next-quarter carry ---
# 1.0 when backwardation AND forward carry is positive, else 0.0
zc_back_hit  = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_back) and zc_fwd_back > 0) else 0.0
zc_back_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_back) and zc_fwd_back <= 0) else 0.0

zs_back_hit  = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_back) and zs_fwd_back > 0) else 0.0
zs_back_miss = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_back) and zs_fwd_back <= 0) else 0.0

# Expanding hit rate (% of backwardation days where fwd carry > 0)
zc_hit_rate = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_hit) /
              (cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_miss))

zs_hit_rate = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_hit) /
              (cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_hit) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_miss))

# --- % of days in each regime (expanding) ---
# ZC
zc_back_flag = 1.0 if zc_in_backwardation else 0.0
zc_cont_flag = 1.0 if zc_in_contango else 0.0
zc_total_days = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_flag) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_cont_flag)
zc_pct_back = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_back_flag) / zc_total_days
zc_pct_cont = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zc_cont_flag) / zc_total_days

# ZS
zs_back_flag = 1.0 if zs_in_backwardation else 0.0
zs_cont_flag = 1.0 if zs_in_contango else 0.0
zs_total_days = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_flag) + cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_cont_flag)
zs_pct_back = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_back_flag) / zs_total_days
zs_pct_cont = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(zs_cont_flag) / zs_total_days

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Regime Stats & Predictive Power
# Rows: ZC Backwardation | ZC Contango | ZS Backwardation | ZS Contango
# Cols: % Days | Avg Carry | Avg Fwd Carry (63d) | Hit Rate (fwd>0)
# =============================================================================
# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1a: Expanding Hit Rate — ZC
# % of backwardation days where 63d forward carry was positive (expanding window)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn (ZC): Does Backwardation Predict Positive 63d Carry? (Expanding Hit Rate)',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% of Backwardation Days)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC Hit Rate', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=zc_hit_rate)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1b: Expanding Hit Rate — ZS
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Does Backwardation Predict Positive 63d Carry? (Expanding Hit Rate)',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% of Backwardation Days)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZS Hit Rate', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=zs_hit_rate)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1c: Avg 63d Forward Carry by Regime — ZC
# Backwardation vs Contango: which regime predicts higher forward carry?
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Corn (ZC): Avg 63d Forward Carry by Regime',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63d Forward Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=2
)(zc_fwd_back, zc_fwd_cont)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1d: Avg 63d Forward Carry by Regime — ZS
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Avg 63d Forward Carry by Regime',
    category='1. Predictive Power',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63d Forward Carry',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=3
)(zs_fwd_back, zs_fwd_cont)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: ZC Carry Time Series — Regime Colored
# Blue = backwardation (carry > 0), Red = contango (carry < 0)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn (ZC): Curve Slope — Backwardation (Blue) vs Contango (Red)',
    category='2. Curve Slope',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat Curve')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zc_carry_back, zc_carry_cont))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: ZS Carry Time Series — Regime Colored
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Soybeans (ZS): Curve Slope — Backwardation (Blue) vs Contango (Red)',
    category='2. Curve Slope',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat Curve')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Backwardation', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zs_carry_back, zs_carry_cont))
